adopted_reference_note: Step25 selected=null; the subsequent programme adopted and froze RZ75. Later seeds are new simulation realisations, not an independent empirical validation dataset.

metadata.uncertainty: Mean ±1 sample SD across runs (ddof=1); record 95% block-bootstrap CI

a.weighting: Equal fish within event/category, equal nonempty events within run, equal runs

c.within_run: Mean of eligible exit-to-next-release intervals pooled within breathing type

d.measure: Total time with whole-shoal median height below 1 BL within end-to-next-start interval; linearly interpolated threshold crossings

e.window: Complete 40 s windows; display 0–30 s; intervening events retained; schooling agents only

f.correlation: Spearman rho between participation class (1–4) and next collective interval
f.variant_note: No-rest and weaker-rest each retain 3 saved runs. Historical elapsed times ~24 and 20 min/run: extending both to 10 needs ~5 CPU hours; no new simulations run. Weaker-rest uses its existing re-estimated isolated-fish depletion rates.

supplementary_rise_check.definition: Time from each completed event end to the next sampled upward crossing of 1 BL by whole-shoal median height. Events without an observed later crossing are excluded. Multiple events in one rise share the next crossing; no independent-event inference.

plateau.definition: Original figure includes intervening events and uses mean drive of schooling fish only. Membership decomposition at full-precision transition times uses symmetric departure/return order when simultaneous. Reserve reconstruction differs from discrete integration by at most one time step of consumption.
plateau.note: Before-next-event curves condition on remaining event-free; they are selected subsets, not a causal no-breathing counterfactual.
